channel.title: Chronohaze Notes Feed
channel.description: Research notes and technical updates from Feier Lyu on optimization, Isabelle/HOL, and related mathematical work.

item.title: Second-Order Geometry in Network Localization: A Research Overview
item.description: A concise overview of collaborative research with Prof. Shoham Sabach and Owen Li on second-order geometry in network localization.

item.title: Formalizing Submodular Greedy Is Now in the AFP
item.description: A short reflection on the publication of an Isabelle/HOL formalization of submodular greedy algorithms in the Archive of Formal Proofs, and on the proof architecture exposed by formalization.

item.title: TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking
item.description: A technical note on two-timescale GDA, hypergradient tracking, and second-order control in nonconvex minimax optimization.

item.title: Moving Forward After Submodular Optimization: Projected Gradient Descent in Isabelle/HOL
item.description: Originally posted on May 22, this note preserves the design-stage narrative; the sole-authored formalization is now published in AFP as First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL.

item.title: Classical Greedy, LazyGreedy, and StochasticGreedy in Isabelle/HOL
item.description: Originally posted on March 14; the July update adds later status without changing the original date. The submodular entry was published in AFP on May 26, and the repository continued afterward with the StochasticGreedy theorem line.

item.title: Metalcore Piano Lab | From Audio to Chart: A Discretization Experiment (WIP)
item.description: From continuous audio to playable charts: onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints.

item.title: Spring 2026 | A New Research Direction
item.description: Beginning undergraduate research in Cornell ORIE on first-order methods for constrained and composite optimization.

item.title: Early Project Note: Formalising Submodular Greedy
item.description: A December 2025 stage record; the project was subsequently published in AFP 2026, and the current repository also contains a post-publication StochasticGreedy extension.

item.title: My First Isabelle Formalization Project
item.description: Embedding verifiability into proof writing: from motivation to the Nemhauser–Wolsey theorem.
